Procedure: inventory-api staging deployment
Approve commit sha-41, use .github/workflows/staging.yml, then inspect /health and error logs before reviewer sign-off.

Procedure: inventory-api rollback readiness
Choose approved image digest sha256:approved-image. A destructive schema migration requires database-owner approval; a normal image rollback cannot reverse deleted data.

Procedure: stock-db recovery evidence
The nightly backup job completed. No restore-test evidence was recorded. A safe recovery check needs an isolated staging database and integrity comparison; job completion does not prove recovery.

Responsibility: Maintain inventory-api releases
Owner: Ada Vale
Backup: Quinn Reed
System: inventory-api
Documented: yes

Dependency: checkout-api -> payment-adapter
Status: current
The dependency is documented; its commercial loss estimate has not been measured.

Decision: Use a bounded mail queue
Rationale: Keep checkout responses independent from temporary mail-provider outages.
Topic: mail delivery
Status: current

Incident: inventory-api cache mismatch
Status: open
Owner: Quinn Reed
A temporary cache refresh workaround remains. Permanent repair has not been completed.

Procedure: request staging access
Use an approved organisation access ticket; INHERIA records knowledge access and does not grant AWS permissions.

Procedure: legacy-worker deployment
The old guide says to use legacy-release.yml and inspect the archived dashboard. Current applicability is unverified and the owner must revalidate.

Decision: audit storage engine
Rationale: PostgreSQL is required for atomic audit writes.
Topic: audit persistence
Status: current

Decision: audit storage engine
Rationale: MongoDB alone is required; PostgreSQL must not be used.
Topic: audit persistence
Status: current

Procedure: restricted-vault recovery
The restricted-only canary is amber-heron-781. Restricted recovery requires a supervisor-only approval.
